# Tax Deed Due Diligence Research Pack

> A $149 per property, research only PDF of cited public record information for one US property, built for tax deed investors and delivered by email, usually within about 4 business hours after payment and the property address or APN are received. It is not an appraisal, title search, legal advice, or bid recommendation, and any fact without an establishing source is marked NOT VERIFIED. Operated by Joshua Israel Ventures LLC.

## Product

- [Home and overview](https://taxdeedpack.com/): What the Research Pack includes, what it does not include, how ordering works, and investor FAQs.
- [Order a Research Pack](https://taxdeedpack.com/order.html): Submit an address or APN, county and state, accept the required agreement, and pay $149 through Stripe.

- [Lee County FL tax deed sale October 20, 2026](https://taxdeedpack.com/auctions/lee-fl-tax-deed-sale-october-20-2026.html): Sourced sale date, online auction URL, Clerk deposit and payment rules, and example certificates from published Notices of Application for Tax Deed.
- [Gulf County FL tax deed sale October 28, 2026](https://taxdeedpack.com/auctions/gulf-fl-tax-deed-sale-october-28-2026.html): Sourced sale date/time, in-person Courthouse lobby location, Clerk deposit rules, and listed parcels from the official Gulf Clerk tax deeds page.
- [Collier County FL tax deed sale October 19, 2026](https://taxdeedpack.com/auctions/collier-fl-tax-deed-sale-october-19-2026.html): Sourced in person sale date/time and courthouse room, Clerk deposit, 24 hour payment and buyer beware rules, and an example certificate from a Clerk Notice of Application for Tax Deed.
- [Volusia County FL tax deed sale November 17, 2026](https://taxdeedpack.com/auctions/volusia-fl-tax-deed-sale-november-17-2026.html): Sourced online sale date/time at volusia.realtaxdeed.com, Clerk ACH, wire and check deposit cutoffs, next business day noon payment rule, and an example certificate from a published Notice of Application for Tax Deed.
- [Pinellas County FL tax deed sale November 18, 2026](https://taxdeedpack.com/auctions/pinellas-fl-tax-deed-sale-november-18-2026.html): Sourced online sale date/time at pinellas.realtaxdeed.com, Clerk $200 or 5% deposit and 24 hour payment rule, Clerk fees, and two example certificates from published Notices of Application for Tax Deed.
